phase_name: Correct the stale prose and remediation instructions

objectives.description: Correct the 4 high-priority mis-diagnosis/advisory-string files named directly by the plan
objectives.note: All 4 rewritten per plan guidance. check-extension-docs.sh had 10 distinct sites (more than the plan's prose implied).

objectives.description: Sweep the 7 lower-priority files the plan named
objectives.note: context/standards/task-management.md's grep hit ('Sync all tasks') confirmed a false positive (/task --sync command flag, unrelated) -- no edit needed there. task-lock.sh and orchestrate-batch-admit.sh both carried the same mis-diagnosis pattern as objective 1's rule-file fix and were rewritten, not just button-label-patched.

objectives.description: Widened sweep for the 11 Phase-2-retired per-category copy_* function names (a staleness class the plan's own Scope Hypothesis grep pattern did not cover)
objectives.note: loader-reference.md and extension-system.md's Loader section needed comprehensive rewrites (full API reference docs for the retired 11-function architecture). Also found and fixed a third staleness class: both permission-configuration.md and extension-system.md described the wipe sequence's restore step as running AFTER manager.regenerate, the pre-Phase-5 buggy ordering Phase 5 specifically fixed.

objectives.description: Final grep sweeps (stale short-form module path, retired button labels, retired function names) and line-count regeneration for doc-lint
objectives.note: grep -rn 'neotex.shared.extensions|neotex/shared/extensions' agent-system/extensions/ returns zero (the one occurrence was inside the objective-1 mis-diagnosis note, already corrected). generate-context-line-counts.sh --write (run from the deployed copy per its own root-guard) recomputed line_count for every file this phase changed, and as a side effect also fixed the one pre-existing formats/summary-format.md mismatch that predated this task. verify-deploy.sh now reports a full 16/16 PASS, 0 failures -- the first time in this task's lifetime.

deviations.description: Plan's Scope Hypothesis said 5 high-priority files plus 7 lower-priority sweeps, derived from a grep pattern (Load Core|Sync all|load_all_globally|shared/extensions)
deviations.reason: That grep pattern does not match the 11 Phase-2-retired per-category copy_* function names (copy_simple_files, copy_skill_dirs, copy_context_dirs, copy_scripts, copy_hooks, copy_docs, copy_templates, copy_systemd, copy_root_files, copy_data_dirs, copy_manifest), which is a second, independent staleness class the plan did not anticipate. A broader sweep found and fixed 7 additional files, including two full reference-guide documents needing comprehensive rewrites.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered — scope widening, see plan Phase 8 notes)*
